record.title: Arida strike-related closure and restricted returnee reopening, November–December 2024
record.direction: Closure direction not fully reconstructed; endpoint is Syria to Lebanon only.

record.enforcement: Scope-limited evidence; uniform enforcement beyond the named crossings and movement categories is not inferred.
record.relationship: Separate northern post from ME028 Masnaa and ME029 Qaa. Followed by renewed 6 December closure, recorded separately.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources only; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Deliberate military interdiction of border routes; event-specific military justification not independently established.
record.context: Northern border infrastructure was struck just before the Lebanon ceasefire.
record.uncertainty: First limited returnee access is bounded December 1–2; onset remains November 26–27. Later vehicle reopening is not the first access.
